quest.title: A-Toymaking We Shall Go: Energy Storage
quest.description: Bertrand's machine seems to have finished processing the materials. One process down — now for the next...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

talks.objective: Go to Ritou and look for Bertrand

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Bertrand!

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: #Ah, {NICKNAME} and Paimon. Splendiferous timing.

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: My one and only Great Machine has finished processing the materials you collected.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And how did that go?

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: Well, come now, this is a machine that I created! Of course there were no issues at all! My techniques were, after all, forged in the fires of Fontaine!

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: And of course, none know the operation and workings of such devices better than we, the people of Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: I blame the previous, ah, explosive nature of the product on rushed preparation and a lack of helping hands to help hoover up the necessary materials. Things will be different this time!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you say...

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: If it still explodes... Well, then my final deposit and the rest of my life will go up in smoke too.

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: So even if you don't believe in me, you can have faith in my resolution to put my life on the line for this!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y'know, Paimon never thought that this toymaking thingamajig was supposed to require that much resolve...

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: Well, regardless, we need to begin on the next step of our work.

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: For safety's sake, let me just ask you this first: of the three processes, the one we have completed is "Source Material Collection."

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: Now then, is the next step "Core Collection" or "Charge Collection"?

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: Congratulations... on being wrong. If you really did go out and do that, then you'd have a part in the collapse of my fortunes.

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: The correct answer is Elemental Charge.

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: Well, all in all... This Elemental Charge is essentially performed by being affected by the elements while carrying the Material Collector.

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: For example, I could stand in a river while carrying the Collector to collect Hydro. If I wanted to collect Electro...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You'd need to be struck by lightning?

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: I believe that you have an adventurer's constitution.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Oh, so it's our constitution you believe in...

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: To be honest, coming into contact with elemental life forms is probably our best bet. During my previous travels in Inazuma, I marked out three different locations frequented by elemental beings...

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: I'd actually wanted to sneak over there by boat and make contact with those creatures myself, if no help came...

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: Well, now that you're here, why don't you go and try your luck in those places?

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: Yes, indeed, I believe I shall leave this to you!

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: Well, it would seem so... But in truth, the answer isn't "Charge Collection" but rather, "Elemental Charge." Didn't expect me to give you two wrong options, eh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This guy's laughter is pretty annoying...

talks.objective: Go near the marked location and have Pyro applied to you for 15s

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: Hmm... The elements within the Collector will have to be transferred into the Machine after each collection, so one production cycle will require three collection trips... This seems like a bit too much busywork.

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: Let me see if I can find some way to optimize this...

talks.objective: Go near the marked location and have Hydro applied to you for 15s
Go near the marked location and have Electro applied to you for 15s
Return the Material Collector to Bertrand

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: How are things going with the Material Collector? Operations are smooth, I trust?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Quite so.

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: The Collector, too, is my pride and joy. Whether it be the collection of source materials as we did before or the storage of elemental energies as it presently does, it can do them all.

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: To tell the truth, I've been having some thoughts about changing the Material Collector's name...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh, Paimon thinks it's fine the way it is.

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: Really? I thought that it might be understating the device's capabilities a little, honestly.

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: Well, whatever the case, pass me the Material Collector. Just as before, the trial production run will require some observation, especially with regard to the use of elemental energy.

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: We'll most likely be able to proceed only after the elemental reactions within the Great Machine stabilize.

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: Well, I'll be counting on you once that happens.
